about: Context for index.html: buildings, roads and canals around campus, same local metres as the map (origin 13.82156,100.51408). Boxes from back.html (fitted to Microsoft ML footprints); polys = OSM / Microsoft footprints (height 0 = unknown, drawn 2 storeys); roads from OSM. Built 2026-10-29. Fidelity pass 2026-10-29: boxes whose real footprint is not a rectangle are drawn from that footprint (in polys, floor count still an estimate); boxes with no footprint data behind them are left out.
